explication: Mini Tokyo 3D is a browser-based, real-time 3D map of Tokyo public transport. The main workflow is user interaction with the map: it loads static and timetable data, refreshes live vehicle information, then renders transport movement and map layers; users can search routes and inspect stations, trains, and buses. The graph also preserves major visualization and UI capabilities. Edges reflect shown calls or README descriptions; some unsampled subsystem wiring is omitted rather than inferred.
